description: Source code for email batching functionality in Mattermost, including classes and methods for batching, scheduling, and sending email notifications related to posts and channels.

classes.name: postData
classes.description: Data structure representing email content for a post notification, including sender info, message, channel info, and attachments.

classes.name: EmailBatchingJob
classes.description: Class managing batching, scheduling, and processing of email notifications for posts.

methods.name: InitEmailBatching
methods.description: Initializes email batching if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: AddNotificationEmailToBatch
methods.description: Adds a notification email to the batching queue or falls back to immediate send if full.

methods.name: NewEmailBatchingJob
methods.description: Creates a new email batching job with specified buffer size.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the email batching job, scheduling periodic checks.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the email batching job, cancelling scheduled tasks.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Queues a new notification for batching.

methods.name: CheckPendingEmails
methods.description: Checks and processes pending batched emails.

methods.name: handleNewNotifications
methods.description: Handles incoming notifications and adds them to pending list.

methods.name: checkPendingNotifications
methods.description: Processes pending notifications based on timing and user preferences.

methods.name: truncateUserNames
methods.description: Truncates user names longer than specified length, appending ellipsis.

methods.name: sendBatchedEmailNotification
methods.description: Constructs and sends batched email notifications to users.
